supersedes: Version1 UUID-as-display-number policy is superseded by the direct human numeric-numbering and desktop-no-label request.

authoritativeMetadata.type: optional canonical positive decimal string without leading zero
authoritativeMetadata.scope: global independent sequence per type across all users
authoritativeMetadata.source: 08 service-only atomic registry and confirmed read projection; original raw pet JSON, old serial, immutable receipts and archive bytes are not rewritten.
authoritativeMetadata.trust: The UI formatter does not authenticate an imported or claimed number.08 must strip/reject unverified numeric metadata before exposing the trusted canonical DTO.
authoritativeMetadata.offline: Only service-confirmed metadata from the non-backup main-process cache may be projected. Absent or unconfirmed metadata stays absent; never allocate locally or fall back to a UUID, old serial or unverified cache value.

fields.roleName: Catalog character.name by immutable original templateId, independent of mutable appearance/resourceId and stored historical nickname.
fields.instanceNumber: Only a canonical globalSerial string matching /^[1-9][0-9]*$/ is formatted with padStart(4,"0"). Never convert through JS Number, truncate, wrap or regenerate. Missing/invalid metadata displays 待同步.
fields.historicalNickname: Original stored pet.name when different from roleName; otherwise null. Unknown historical templates use 历史伙伴 and retain their original nickname.

examples.afterCapture: Keep2 when binding to the original owned petId.

invariants: Commands, ownership, action idempotency, selection, history and resource rendering still use original ownerAccountId+petId or the existing wild spawn key. Display text never selects an instance.

Do not write the projection or globalSerial into old companion data_json, old action results or old archived envelopes.08 keeps authority metadata in a private sidecar and projects only after verification.
Keep fixed roleName and numeric display label together in public selectors/details. Never expose UUID or old serial as the public number.
Equal numeric labels across different types are valid. Same-type authoritative registry numbers are globally distinct. Pending text is not an instance identifier.
No renderer mutation grants, replaces or increments globalSerial. Existing adoption/capture inputs and original petId are not changed to fabricate allocation.

wild.allocation: Number on the first validated observe when a user opens the target encounter. Nearby map refresh alone must not batch-allocate.
wild.retries: Observe/reserve/re-entry/retry retain the same number; capture binds that original number to the original new owned petId.
wild.policy: Preserve per-account wild-instance semantics and existing location/range/capture rules; do not make a map cell globally exclusive.

desktop.source: DesktopCompanion.tsx renders the shared portrait and interaction controls, with no visible name/number element; original internal data-pet-id remains technical metadata.

adoption.newUi: Submit the selected catalog role name; no arbitrary-name input or role rename control. Success uses the current verified snapshot matching both ownerAccountId and petId. A historical receipt fallback is cloned without globalSerial and remains pending; it cannot assert authority or hide newer confirmed metadata.
adoption.legacyCompatibility: Original stored names, raw serials, IDs and old rename/adoption receipts remain unchanged.

dto.owned: CompanionPet adds globalSerial?:string. IPC list/get and main listPets/getPet must carry only08 verified sidecar projection, with no backup mutation.
dto.wildAndDiscovery: DiscoveryPet,WildSpawn,DiscoveryCapture add the same optional field.03 owns their trusted mapping, observe and capture inheritance.
dto.sourceType: CompanionIdentitySource requires templateId/name and optional globalSerial; petId is optional for projection only. Rendering/actions still retain the original proper key.
dto.missingTemplateId: Do not guess a role from resourceId. Read the current authenticated owned get/identity API or add original templateId/identity to the read-only DTO.

coordinatorRouting.status: consumer-contract-ready; server numbering/cache and integrated acceptance pending
owners: 05 garden number labels and async ownership checks
coordinatorRouting.request: Consume the same helper/identity API, preserve raw history and action IDs, and use 待同步 for unknown metadata. Each domain owns its DTO propagation.

validationBoundary: 02 tests prove formatting, missing-field behavior, immutable source/SQLite preservation and type/bundle compatibility. They do not allocate numbers or prove live global concurrency/capture authority.08/03 and09 own those proofs.
